description: The plot illustrates the model's Eval PPL under different sparsity settings applied to Attention and FFN components at varying ratios. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio(%)" and features a linear scale that decreases from left to right, ranging from 100 to 25 with tick marks at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL." and uses a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The plot contains four lines. The "Transformer" line is a red dashed line with no markers that remains constant at a y-value of approximately 11.6 across the entire x-axis. The "Only MoHD FFN" line is a solid grey line with square markers; it starts at an x-value of 100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, dips slightly to roughly 11.3 at x=75, remains steady at 11.3 at x=50, and rises to approximately 11.8 at x=25. The "Only MoHD ATTN" line is a solid dark blue line with circular markers; it begins at x=100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, increases to roughly 11.6 at x=75, rises to about 12.3 at x=50, and peaks at approximately 14.3 at x=25. Finally, the "MoHD ATTN + MLP" line is a solid light blue line with 'x' markers; it starts at x=100 with a y-value of approximately 11.4, rises slightly to about 11.5 at x=75, increases to roughly 12.1 at x=50, and ends at approximately 13.2 at x=25.
